lords.theme: Lord's cricket ground in London on a sunny summer Test day, in cartoon form
lords.far: the grand red-brick Victorian pavilion with its twin turrets and long balconies of members, with the white futuristic curved media-centre pod high up beside it and the Old Father Time weather vane on a stand roof, under a blue sky
lords.sides: elegant white tented stand canopies, tiers of members in red-and-yellow striped blazers and boaters, champagne picnics
lords.crowd: chunky cricket members in red-and-yellow striped ties and blazers, straw boaters and panama hats

oval.theme: The Oval cricket ground in south London on a sunny afternoon, in cartoon form
oval.far: the famous round Victorian gasholder iron frames rising behind a red-brick pavilion with a clock, and modern white stands
oval.sides: modern stands with chocolate-brown seats, London flats and a red double-decker bus peeking past the stand
oval.crowd: chunky Surrey fans in chocolate-brown caps and scarves

headingley.theme: Headingley cricket ground in Leeds, Yorkshire, on a bright day, in cartoon form
headingley.far: a big modern double-sided stand with a white roof, rows of Yorkshire white-rose banners, and the rolling Yorkshire hills and stone terraced houses beyond
headingley.sides: the lively Western Terrace packed with fans in fancy dress, dark green seats and Yorkshire stone walls
headingley.crowd: chunky Yorkshire fans in fancy dress (bananas, superheroes, nuns) and flat caps

edgbaston.theme: Edgbaston cricket ground in Birmingham on a lively summer evening, in cartoon form
edgbaston.far: the sweeping modern pavilion with a curved white roof and glass boxes, and the Birmingham city skyline behind
edgbaston.sides: the famous rowdy Hollies Stand with fans in fancy dress and giant inflatables, navy and sky-blue seats
edgbaston.crowd: chunky Bears fans in navy and sky blue, some dressed as cartoon bears

oldtrafford.theme: Old Trafford cricket ground in Manchester on a showery bright day, in cartoon form
oldtrafford.far: the old red-brick pavilion and the striking jagged red modern conference building behind it, with a rainbow and fluffy rain clouds in the sky
oldtrafford.sides: red seats, umbrellas and rain macs, red-brick Manchester terraces and mill chimneys
oldtrafford.crowd: chunky Lancashire fans in red rain macs and red-rose scarves, some with umbrellas
oldtrafford.light: bright sun breaking through clouds from top-left

trentbridge.theme: Trent Bridge cricket ground in Nottingham on a sunny day, in cartoon form
trentbridge.far: the historic red-brick Trent Bridge pavilion with its clock and white balconies, and beyond it the River Trent with an old iron bridge, rowing boats and swans
trentbridge.sides: the red-brick Radcliffe Road stand, green-and-gold seats and old trees
trentbridge.crowd: chunky Notts fans in green and gold, some in Robin Hood hats with feathers
trentbridge.ring: low dark forest-green boundary boards, much darker than the bright field
